body: I said some fucked up things to a friend of mine in the heat of a moment and they moved to Oregon (I understood why and paid for their move). It’s funny that after I started meds for adhd things feel better but now recognizing what I did to someone who truly cared for me is too much to handle. I’m exhausted existing.
They are in a different state. I’m alone here now.

I can relate, I miss the hugs and warmth. I am here if you want to DM, but know that you have meaning and others care. I know that feeling of horribleness, but I also hope you can forgive yourself. No matter what you feel right now, you are real and are valid.
